title: Portfólio de projetos
noData: Nenhum projeto encontrado neste período. Tente outro período.
errorTitle: Não foi possível carregar o portfólio
errorDescription: Algo deu errado ao carregar o relatório.
openingTip: Projects that started before this period and were still open when it began. Uses the project start date, or the created date when no start date is set.
newTip: Projects whose start date falls in this period. Uses the created date when no start date is set.
closeTip: Projects now Completed or Cancelled that were last updated in this period. Projects have no closed date, so the last update is used as the close date.
closingTip: Projects still open at the end of this period: Opening + New − Close.
